definitions.explanation: A person who steals things, especially by breaking into houses.

examples.japanese: {泥棒|どろぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}られた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A burglar broke in. / We were robbed.

examples.japanese: {泥棒|どろぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
{泥棒|どろぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{泥棒|どろぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A thief broke in while we were away.

examples.japanese: {泥棒|どろぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: The thief escaped through the window.

notes:
{泥棒|どろぼう} typically refers to burglars or thieves who break into homes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {泥棒|どろぼう}に{入|はい}られる: to be burglarized
- {泥棒|どろぼう}を{捕|つか}まえる: to catch a thief
- {泥棒|どろぼう}{猫|ねこ}: cat burglar; sneaky person

RELATED TERMS:
- {窃盗|せっとう}: theft (legal/formal term)
- {空|あ}き{巣|す}: burglar (when residents are away)
- {万引|まんび}き: shoplifting
- {強盗|ごうとう}: robbery (with violence/threat)

Note: {泥棒|どろぼう} is also used figuratively: {時間|じかん}{泥棒|どろぼう} (time thief - something that wastes time)
